'''Sandrine Bony-Léna''', née '''Bony''', is a French-born climatologist who is currently Director of research at the [[Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique]] (CNRS) at [[Sorbonne University]], Paris. Bony was notably a lead author of the [[Nobel Prize]]-winning (2007) ''Fourth Assessment Report'' of the [[Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.frontiersofknowledgeawards-fbbva.es/jurado/sandrine-bony-2/#:~:text=Sandrine%20Bony%20is%20Director%20of%20Research%20with%20the,response%20of%20the%20climate%20system%20to%20human%20activity|title=Frontiers of Knowledge Awards|website=www.frontiersofknowledgeawards-fbbva.es|access-date=8 February 2021}}</ref>

==Distinctions==
* 2012: the Bernard Haurwitz Memorial Lecture prize awarded by the [[American Meteorological Society]] (AMS).<ref>{{cite web|date=2012|title=PRIX & DISTINCTIONS SCIENTIFIQUES ET PÉDAGOGIQUES 2012|url=http://www.univ-paris-est.fr/fichiers/Prix%26distinctions_2012-2.pdf|website=www.univ-paris-est.fr|language=fr|access-date=8 March 2021|archive-date=9 July 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170709052726/http://www.univ-paris-est.fr/fichiers/Prix%26distinctions_2012-2.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* 2017: the Gérard-Mégie prize of the [[Académie des sciences (France)|Académie des Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|language=fr-fr|title=Lauréate 2017 du prix Gérard Mégie : Sandrine Bony {{!}} Lauréats {{!}} Prix et médailles {{!}} Encourager la vie scientifique|url=http://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Laureats/laureat-2017-prix-gerard-megie.html|website=www.academie-sciences.fr|access-date=1 May 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|author=Académie des sciences|title=Lauréate 2017 du prix Gérard Mégie : Sandrine Bony|website=[[YouTube]] |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rmXV8J7RTxo|date=20 December 2017|access-date=1 May 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|language=fr|title=Sandrine Bony {{!}} ENS|url=http://www.ens.fr/actualites/sandrine-bony|website=www.ens.fr|access-date=1 May 2018}}</ref>
* 2017: [[Chevalier de la Légion d'honneur]].<ref>{{cite web|language=fr|title=Ordre de la Légion d'Honneur|url=http://www.france-phaleristique.com/lh_promo_12-07-17.htm|website=[[Légifrance]]}}</ref>
*2018: [[CNRS Silver Medal]].<ref>{{cite web|author=ARTIFICA|title=82 nouveaux Talents du CNRS – Communiqués et dossiers de presse -CNRS|url=http://www2.cnrs.fr/presse/communique/5493.htm?theme1=5|access-date=27 April 2018|website=www2.cnrs.fr|language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Sandrine Bony {{!}} CNRS|url=http://www.cnrs.fr/fr/personne/sandrine-bony|access-date=28 April 2018|website=www.cnrs.fr|language=fr}}</ref>
* 2023: [[Buys Ballot Medal]]
